title: Block In The Bucket x32
body:
This pack displays the blocks contained in the sulfur cube buckets.

![Overview of all the textures in the pack for the x32 version](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SDheC5Xh/images/e601eca90f62595d0971a92965171a3050aa6255.png)

The pack is available with x16 or Faithful x32 textures, you can find the Vanilla x16 version here: [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/block-in-the-bucket](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/block-in-the-bucket).
